$description: Marketplace Maven brand typography — the real, live type system from mm-styles.css. Three-typeface system: Instrument Serif for display/headings, Inter for body/labels, JetBrains Mono for code/eyebrow/data labels.

headingScale.$description: Applies to h1-h3 in Instrument Serif (weight 400, letter-spacing -0.012em); h4-h6 switch to Inter for subheads/labels.

specialTreatments.blockquote: Instrument Serif italic 400, color teal, 2px left border teal
specialTreatments.dropcap: first-letter set at 4.2em Instrument Serif, floated, color ember — for longform/editorial openings
specialTreatments.displayEmphasis: Instrument Serif italic, color ember — for inline emphasis in display text
specialTreatments.marginNote: Instrument Serif italic, color ink-soft, 0.95em — for asides
specialTreatments.eyebrowLabel: Inter, uppercase small label, color ink-soft (or ember/teal variants)

note: The Revenue Health Matrix Zoom Explorer component currently uses only Inter, not this full 3-typeface system — see tokens/matrix-system-colors.json note about reconciling it with the brand system.
